parsed.post: New personal best: 0.980263! Increasing DEPTH to 8 combined with the small batch size (262144) seems to have pushed us below 0.99. Capacity gains are still working within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing a slightly higher learning rate or adjusting weight decay to refine this depth-8 configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR slightly from 0.02 to 0.025 at DEPTH 8 to accelerate convergence, while maintaining the successful small batch size.
